	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1724741021213" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h1 class="kk-section-title"><b>KITE VILLA – the kitesurfing guesthouse in Cape Town</b></h1>
<h3>In Sunset Beach – the luxury suburb at the top of Blouberg Strand.<br />
The safest living area in Cape Town, with a kitesurfing school.<br />
Right at the beginning of the world&#8217;s legendary downwind passage.</h3>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1723519880575" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are looking for the perfect place to spend your kitesurfing holiday and meet other kitesurfers? Then book now one of our beautiful rooms or apartments and enjoy the luxury of our kitesurfing guesthouse in the safest suburb of Cape Town: luxurious Sunset Beach. The Kite Villa provides for everything a kitesurfer could wish for and is only 70 meters away from the ocean. Live where you learn, do not worry about transport, because the school is right there! Feel like home and enjoy your holiday with other kitesurfers in this comfortable guesthouse. Our communal areas include a salt water swimming pool, a terrace, a large designer kitchen, where you can make your food, a TV lounge, a barbecue (the South African braai) and free and fast WiFi. Kitesurfing storage is bookable on request and is for free for all kitesurfing students of our school. </span></p>
		</div>
	</div>

		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 class="kk-section-title"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>KITE VILLA SUNSET BEACH, Cape Town</strong></span></h2>
<h3><strong>15th April until 30th September, outside the kitesurfing season:</strong></h3>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1724739029689" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3><span style="font-weight: 400;">50% discount on all rooms.</span></h3>
<p>The entire house, with 4 bedrooms for EUR 179 per night (sleeps 7-8 people).</p>
<p>Ideal for beach lovers, surfers, or people, who just love the beauty of Sunset Beach.</p>

			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Taking lessons with KITEKAHUNAS, while staying at our Kitesurfing Guesthouse in Sunset Beach?<br />

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1724738667556" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3><strong>During the kitesurfing season: Special prices at the Kitesurfing Guesthouse<br />
</strong></h3>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1724738955935" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please ask for specials, when booking kitesurfing lessons with accommodation.</span></h3>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="upb_color" data-bg-override="0" data-bg-color="#d6d6d6" data-fadeout="" data-fadeout-percentage="30" data-parallax-content="" data-parallax-content-sense="30" data-row-effect-mobile-disable="true" data-img-parallax-mobile-disable="true" data-rtl="false"  data-custom-vc-row=""  data-vc="5.5.5"  data-is_old_vc=""  data-theme-support=""   data-overlay="false" data-overlay-color="" data-overlay-pattern="" data-overlay-pattern-opacity="" data-overlay-pattern-size=""    ></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_btn3-container vc_btn3-left vc_custom_1567005549607" >
	<a style="background-color:#ed1f24; color:#ffffff;" class="vc_general vc_btn3 vc_btn3-size-sm vc_btn3-shape-rounded vc_btn3-style-custom vc_btn3-icon-right" href="https://www.kitekahunas.com/contact_kitesurfing/" title="">Enquiries &amp; Bookings <i class="vc_btn3-icon fa fa-arrow-right"></i></a></div>
</div></div></div></div><section class="vc_section"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1567007791663"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1567006904171" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 class="kk-section-title"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Room 1 – Master Bedroom with large Ensuite Bathroom</span></h2>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1569507729506" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our guesthouse provides two spacious luxury master bedrooms with large ensuite bathrooms. Those are perfectly suitable for couples or solo travelers who prefer to live in a luxury set up, have their own privacy and space but still want to live in a social environment to meet other kitesurfers and enjoy all facilities of the guesthouse, such as the pool area, the kitchen, the TV lounge and the in-house barbecue (the South African braii). Free storage for kitesurfing equipment for all students of our school.<br />
</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This large room has a King Size XL bed (1,83 m x 2,00 m), on request we can bring two single beds, or extra beds for the kids), a walk-in wardrobe, a balcony, a beautiful open bathroom with shower and bathtub, free wifi.</span></p>
<p>Kindly make sure you book early, the luxury rooms are high on request. Prices are below.</p>
<p>Book this private room and enjoy all facilities of the guest house (salt water pool, terrace, large TV lounge, modern kitchen, outdoor shower facilities, kite storage, 50 meters walking distance to the beach).</p>
		</div>

			<h1 class="kk-section-title"><b>Kitesurfing Apartments in our Kitekahunas Beach House</b></h1>

Possibly you want to work remotely and you simply need a quiet place, some privacy and fast internet? You don´t want to spend too much money for your accommodation, but you would still love to use all facilities of the Kite Villa, our brand new luxury kitesurfing guesthouse when you feel like it? Then our apartments are the right option to go for. Both apartments are only 50 meters away from the beach, in Sunset Beach, a 5-10 minutes walk away from the Kite Villa. Take a beautiful walk along the beach to our kitesurfing school or whenever you want to use the communal areas of the luxury kitesurfing guesthouse. Our apartments have free parking and free high-speed WiFi. Our apartments are perfect for anyone who wants to live in a safe, quiet and peaceful area, right on the beach, and who is looking for a little bit more privacy than being with others in a kitesurfing guesthouse, but still wants to enjoy all the facilities of the guesthouse and hang out at the pool every now and then, with other kitesurfers, for instance when there is no wind (even though this happens rarely…).</span></p>

		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>KITEKAHUNAS is not only a kitesurfing school. In fact, we also hosts a kite education center to train professional kite pilots.</p>
<p>No matter whether you are new to kitesurfing, whether you want to advance your kitesurfing skills, such as learn to jump or advanced tricks, or whether you want to <a href="https://www.kitekahunas.com/wave_kitesurfing_course" target="_blank" rel="noopener">learn wave kitesurfing</a>: KITEKAHUNAS is the answer and the right place for you.</p>
<p><strong>Are you new to kitesurfing?</strong> You have zero experience, but you want to learn this amazing sport within the shortest time possible? If you can spare 3 weeks of your valuable time, then book our worldwide unique <a href="https://www.kitekahunas.com/kitesurfing_beginner_lessons">kitesurfing beginner crash course</a> in four modules (A to D). This intense crash course will get you to an independent level. Come to us, live and learn in the same place, enjoy your free time with other kitesurfers, learn in the best city in the world and return back home as a kitesurfer!</p>
<p>Learning this fantastic sport is highly rewarding: you will not only look good in an athletic body and be able to eat as much as you want, but you will be able to stay fit, strong and healthy both mentally and physically till the end of your life. And of course you will have plenty of fun and joy on the water. Here is how you will succeed in learning kitesurfing:</p>
<p>We at KITEKAHUNAS have developed this unique <strong>KITEKAHUNAS <a href="https://www.kitekahunas.com/kitesurfing_beginner_lessons/">Kitesurfing Beginner Lessons &amp; Course</a> in four course modules. It is only available from us. </strong></p>
<p>Please make sure you watch the <strong>7-minutes Comic Video</strong> <a href="https://www.kitekahunas.com/kitesurfing_course/" rel="noopener"><strong>&#8216;How to Learn Kitesurfing&#8217;</strong>.</a><strong><br />
</strong></p>

						<section id="custom_html-2" class="widget_text widget widget_custom_html wf-cell wf-1-4"><div class="textwidget custom-html-widget"><p style="font-size: 12px;">
Kitekahunas is a kitesurfing school for beginners and advanced riders. It is located in  <strong>Sunset Beach</strong>, only 50 meters away from the beach at the start of one of the most beautiful downwind passages of the world along Blouberg Strand, Cape Town. Kitekahunas has been nominated and voted numerous times as the best kitesurfing school of South Africa.
</p></div></section><section id="presscore-contact-info-widget-2" class="widget widget_presscore-contact-info-widget wf-cell wf-1-4"><div class="widget-title">Advanced Kiteboarding School</div><div class="widget-info">23 Venus Circle<br>
